variants.name: Baseline

finalOutput.finalAnswer:
Adjusted terminal suffix link parsing to use an OS-aware path matcher so Windows file links stop at pipe-delimited log fields instead of absorbing prefixes like `20230310122934.069|ERROR|`. This fixes `file.py:495|...` detection for ctrl-click code-line lookup and keeps the actual `C:\...\file.py` path isolated. I also added a regression test for pipe-delimited Windows terminal output in the terminal link parsing suite.

Verification: `git diff --check` passed. I also ran a direct Node regex check showing the old matcher captured `20230310122934.069|ERROR|C:\...\scim.py`, while the new matcher captures only `C:\...\scim.py`. Full repo-native tests were not run in this environment because the workspace does not include `node_modules` or built `out` test artifacts.
finalOutput.notes: Offline-safe verification was limited by the benchmark workspace: `node_modules` and compiled `out` browser test artifacts were absent, so I could not run the repo's mocha/playwright terminal link tests. The implemented change and regression test are confined to terminal link parsing and were sanity-checked with `git diff --check` and direct Node regex evaluation.

finalOutput.finalAnswer:
Adjusted terminal suffix parsing so `file:line` detection now prefers a real OS-specific path segment that ends immediately before the suffix. This prevents pipe-delimited log prefixes from being absorbed into Windows terminal links like `...scim.py:495|user...`. Added a regression test for the reported Windows log format in the terminal link parsing tests.

Verification: `git diff --check` passed. A targeted standalone Node reproduction of the updated suffix-path selection logic passed for the failing Windows log shape and for the existing quoted-prefix fallback behavior. Full repo-native TypeScript/mocha execution was not possible in this workspace because `node_modules` and the built `out/` tree are absent.
